fold.smart_wheelchairs_carry_sensors_and: Smart wheelchairs carry sensors and computers, and most of them have to come apart before they fit in a car or a closet. CIHANG folds as one piece. Seat, LiDAR, cameras, display and computers stay exactly where they are. Press once, and it drops from 880 mm to 510 mm.

design.it_looks_like_furniture_that:
It looks like furniture.
That's the point.
design.powered_wheelchairs_tend_to_arriv: Powered wheelchairs tend to arrive in black and white, with the machinery on show. CIHANG was co-designed with older adults to be something you would keep in the living room: a low, stable stance, rounded surfaces that wrap around the technical parts, warm low-saturation colors, and solid walnut where your hands rest.
design.alt_side_view_on_white: CIHANG in pure side view on white: walnut armrests, taupe cushions, ivory shell
design.nothing_exposed_nothing_clinical_: Nothing exposed, nothing clinical. Sensors, batteries and actuators sit inside one continuous shell.

design.three_finishes_one_walnut_cream: Three finishes, one walnut. Cream, navy or titanium shell. The armrests stay walnut on all of them.
design.aluminum_alloy_stainless_steel_an: Aluminum alloy, stainless steel and fiber-reinforced composite underneath.
design.flip_up_for_easier_transfers: Flip up for easier transfers in and out.
design.driving_mode_speed_battery_and: Driving mode, speed, battery and alerts. Nothing else.
design.wipe_it_down_without_a: Wipe it down without a second thought.
design.alt_two_cihang_chairs_in: Two CIHANG chairs in a warm wood-panelled living room, one unfolded and one folded, beside a media console
design.at_home_in_the_living: At home in the living room. Open or folded, it reads as a piece of furniture, not equipment.
voice.just_say_where_you_want:
Just say where
you want to go.
voice.cihang_runs_a_language_model: CIHANG runs a language model on its own onboard computer. Your voice never leaves the chair, and it keeps working when the Wi-Fi doesn't. It understands more than 61 Chinese dialects, heavy accents and slower speech, so you talk to it the way you already talk.
voice.on_my_way_i_ll: On my way. I'll go around the coffee table.
voice.speech_recognition_and_the_languag: Speech recognition and the language model run locally. No cloud, no account, no waiting for a server.
voice.nothing_you_say_is_uploaded: Nothing you say is uploaded. The microphone feeds the chair, not a data center.
voice.built_for_regional_dialects_varied: Built for regional dialects, varied accents and slower speech, and for people who change how they talk from day to day.
voice.voice_sits_alongside_the_joystick: Voice sits alongside the joystick, touchscreen, gesture and app control. Use whichever is easier today.
autonomy.it_maps_your_home_on:
It maps your home
on the first drive.
autonomy.two_lidars_and_two_depth: Two LiDARs and two depth cameras scan every room, doorway and threshold as CIHANG moves, and build the map on the spot. From then on it plans its own route, steers around people, pets and furniture in real time, and returns to its dock when the battery runs low. Try it: tap any room on the plan below.

faq.does_it_need_an_internet: Does it need an internet connection?
faq.no_voice_navigation_and_mapping: No. Voice, navigation and mapping run on the chair's own computers. A connection adds app features such as remote monitoring, elevator calling and software updates.
faq.folded_cihang_is_510_mm: Folded, CIHANG is 510 mm tall, down from 880 mm. It stands in a wardrobe, lies flat in a car trunk and fits in equipment rooms and elevators without disassembly.
faq.can_i_still_drive_it: Can I still drive it myself?
faq.yes_use_the_joystick_touchscreen: Yes. Use the joystick, touchscreen, gestures or the app at any time. Release the joystick and the chair stops. Autonomous driving is a mode you switch into, never something forced on you.
faq.older_adults_who_want_to: Older adults who want to keep living at home, people recovering from surgery or injury, long-term wheelchair users, and the families who support them. Care homes, hospitals and rental operators use the Shared version. See the four situations we designed around.
faq.cihang_is_registered_as_a: CIHANG is registered as a Class II medical device with the NMPA and tested to GB/T 12996-2024 and GB/T 18029 / ISO 7176 for wheelchair safety, stability, braking, fatigue durability and EMC. Additional certifications include EU CE (MDR and RoHS), U.S. FDA 510(k) and FCC, Korea KC and MFDS, and UN38.3 battery transport testing.
faq.the_personal_version_is_sold: The personal version is sold direct to consumers online. The shared version is available to institutions through WDC Robot.
